notes: COMPSAC-dataset (P02): deterministic synthetic dataset and split builder delegating entirely to the audited shared kernel evaluation/venue2027/_shared/dataset_kernel.py (generate / detect_split_leakage / assert_no_leakage / assert_valid_frequencies); no split, family-assignment, hash or validation logic re-implemented locally. generate(seed, split=None, n=120) -> kernel Dataset for venue 'compsac' (unit prefix sched-, families clean/omitted_dependency/epoch_race/stale_readset, 60/20/20 split by independent unit, split-independent buffered content hash), augmented with the COMPSAC-specific per-family schedule payload clara.compsac.schedule-payload-v1 (dependency_density family base + seed/idx jitter in [0,1], contention_level sweeping the blueprint worker tiers 1/2/4/8/16, zipf_skew in [0.5,1.5], graph_fanout 1-8 derived from density) computed by pure integer arithmetic from (seed, family, idx) - no RNG object, no clock, no dict iteration order. write_dataset(outdir, seed, n) emits dataset.jsonl (sorted, stable JSON) + inventory.json with per-split/per-family cardinalities, kernel content_sha256, jsonl_sha256 and versions; real artifact generated at research/venue2027/proof/artifacts/compsac_dataset/ (seed=42, n=240, content sha256 bcf74be49842c15345d35e4e2d2a400d0c57f556ae3ac53c2d5cfc156989e889, by_family 60/60/60/60, by_split 144/48/48, guards re-verified on the artifact: assert_no_leakage over train/dev/test views + assert_valid_frequencies both OK). Fail-closed semantics: kernel reason codes UNKNOWN_VENUE/INVALID_N/UNKNOWN_SPLIT/SPLIT_LEAKAGE/INVALID_FAMILY_FREQUENCY/PHI_FIELD_PRESENT plus local UNKNOWN_FAMILY for unregistered schedule families. Tests 12 passed: positive (same seed identical content hash and byte-identical JSONL incl. write_dataset reruns; split filter returns exactly that split with hash/inventory split-independence; inventory totals==n across records, splits, families and written artifacts; no leakage across the three split views; balanced family frequencies within kernel tolerance 0.35; schedule payload present, bounded, deterministic and contention tiers actually sweep {1,2,4,8,16}) and adversarial (same unit_id in two splits detected as SPLIT_LEAKAGE by the kernel; zero-record and dominant families refused INVALID_FAMILY_FREQUENCY; unknown split 'holdout' refused UNKNOWN_SPLIT; unknown family refused UNKNOWN_FAMILY; n<=0 refused INVALID_N; no PHI-named field in any payload or written artifact). baseline_parity=NOT_APPLICABLE: dataset builder, no baseline arms involved. source_sha_after = base SHA per established repo convention (proof report committed together with the work).
